objectives.summary: The project aims to provide an affordable all-in-one solution called 'Stay Together' for caregivers of individuals prone to wandering, such as those with Alzheimer's, Dementia, or Autism. It focuses on maintaining constant communication and support for these individuals, with plans for global expansion and product improvements based on user feedback.

Feedback from testing the trial prototype will be used to improve the product features and functionality.

strategy.summary: The strategy for the LocateMotion project focuses on developing an all-in-one, user-friendly health monitoring solution that is affordable and accessible. The project aims to leverage crowdfunding through Kickstarter to support its development and plans to launch a minimum viable product in Canada and the US, with potential for global reach. The solution includes a GPS-enabled smartwatch and app designed to assist caregivers while maintaining user independence.

innovation.summary: The innovation dimension of the project focuses on developing an all-in-one health monitoring solution that integrates advanced technologies such as GPS, 3G/4G connectivity, and AI features. The product aims to enhance user experience through affordability, simplicity, and extended battery life, while addressing specific needs of caregivers and vulnerable individuals.
key_points: The solution is positioned as an all-in-one product for health monitoring, designed to be user-friendly and accessible.
The first generation of the product is an IoT smartwatch, with future generations planned to include low powered devices like a pendant or wallet card.
The second generation will have capabilities to measure vital health stats like EKG and sugar levels for proactive health monitoring.
The watch minimizes battery consumption by using only necessary optimized apps and intermittently sending location data to servers.
The team is working on technology to improve battery life to months in future generation product releases.
